title: 上下文拼接与去重：相似度过滤 + crc32 指纹
expected_output:
原始块数 = 6
相似度过滤后块数 = 5
指纹去重后块数 = 4
指纹示例(crc32) = 0x74b17232
去重前字符数 = 108
去重后字符数 = 70
压缩率 = 0.6481
code:
import zlib
import numpy as np
chunks = [
    'RAG 通过检索外部知识增强大模型。',
    'RAG 通过检索外部知识增强大模型。',
    '向量数据库用于存储 embedding。',
    '向量数据库用于存储 embedding。',
    'BM25 是一种稀疏检索方法。',
    'HNSW 是常用的 ANN 索引。',
]

def emb(c):
    v = np.zeros(26)
    for ch in c:
        if 'a' <= ch <= 'z':
            v[ord(ch) - ord('a')] += 1
    n = np.linalg.norm(v)
    return v / n if n > 0 else v

embs = [emb(c) for c in chunks]
THRESH = 0.95
kept_idx = []
for i in range(len(chunks)):
    is_dup = False
    for j in kept_idx:
        if float(np.dot(embs[i], embs[j])) > THRESH:
            is_dup = True
            break
    if not is_dup:
        kept_idx.append(i)

final = []
seen_fp = set()
for i in kept_idx:
    fp = zlib.crc32(chunks[i].encode('utf-8')) & 0xffffffff
    if fp in seen_fp:
        continue
    seen_fp.add(fp)
    final.append(i)

before = sum(len(c) for c in chunks)
after = sum(len(chunks[i]) for i in final)
print('原始块数 =', len(chunks))
print('相似度过滤后块数 =', len(kept_idx))
print('指纹去重后块数 =', len(final))
print('指纹示例(crc32) =', hex(zlib.crc32(chunks[0].encode('utf-8')) & 0xffffffff))
print('去重前字符数 =', before)
print('去重后字符数 =', after)
print('压缩率 =', round(after / before, 4))
